summary: Market --select notes now counts as matched (notes is always present), so a populated store exits 0 and the all-miss warning lists the same valid fields as the generic selector, including notes; notes,bogus keeps the partial-miss warning. The composite legacy note is decided against the explicit notes list only and joined with semicolons, so a composite is never added as an entry. market_results upsert is best-position-wins only (the page arm let a worse in-response duplicate overwrite). The demand-state and shop_name sentences are restored in research.json and which.go, README and SKILL carry the research.json market guidance verbatim, and a drift test enforces it plus which/research command parity.
reason: Round-3 review found that --select notes exited 2 on a populated store, that a composite note leaked into notes when summary notes were joined with a space or composite detection ran after resume_hint was added, and that two documentation sentences were lost from the market snapshot guidance.
validated_outcome: Archive-only mutation-verify proofs for seven hazards were caught with exact failure text, knock-outs and controls; see market-r4-proof.md. Full go test ./... passes.
